say:1:1141111001:1.text: When I was little, this desert seemed so vast and boundless. I thought I would run to my death without reaching the edge.
say:1:1141111001:1.source_cn: 小的时候觉得这片沙漠无边无际，就是跑断腿也走不到尽头。

say:2:1141111002:1.text: I used to stare at the end of the desert, waiting for Pops to come home.
say:2:1141111002:1.source_cn: 那时候总是望着沙漠的尽头，盼着老爹回来。

say:3:1141111003:1.text: Because he always brought food with him!
say:3:1141111003:1.source_cn: 嘿，因为老爹回来我们就有好吃的啦！

say:4:1141111004:1.text: Now it's the children of Uru waiting for my return.
say:4:1141111004:1.source_cn: 现在不一样啦，乌尔的孩子们开始等着我回来了。
